description: For unary \(Q\) and a constant \(a\), the fresh-copy inference from \(\{Q(x_1)\}\) and \(\{\neg Q(a)\}\) selects both unit literals, uses exactly \([a/x_2]\) as a most general unifier, and concludes the empty clause.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.worked_second_step.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (Q : L.Relations 1)
  (a : L.Functions 0) :
  ∃ d,
    d.positiveFamily =
        {Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.signed true
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.unaryAtom Q (FirstOrder.Language.var 2))} ∧
      d.negativeFamily =
          {Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.signed false
              (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.unaryAtom Q (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.constant a))} ∧
        d.unifier = Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.workedNu a ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d = ∅
